name: EXM_AIRFARE_POL_LINES
description: This table contains details of a given airfare policy.

columns.name: POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Airfare policy rate line identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AIRFARE_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Policy identifier for which rates are defined.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if this line is a base airline line or a catch all line.

columns.name: FLIGHT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Airline ticket class such as economy class or business class.

columns.name: FLIGHT_CLASS_CODE_DOMESTIC
columns.description: Airline ticket class such as economy class or business class, for domestic flights.

columns.name: FLIGHT_CLASS_CODE_INTERNAT
columns.description: Airline ticket class such as economy class or business class, for international flights.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date at the beginning of the date range within which the rate is valid.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date at the end of the date range within which the rate is valid.

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: Role for which this rate is applicable.

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Role name for which this rate is applicable, such as Director or Engineer.

columns.name: FLIGHT_DURATION_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Expense manager can specify a flight duration threshold such that above the threshold or below the threshold, a different flight class can be used. For example, policy can be defined such that if flight duration is more than seven hours, employee can fly business class.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the rate line, such as Valid, Active, and Invalid. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: INVALID_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating the reason that the rate line failed validation. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_INVALID_CODE.
